Meta.description: On-chain K-pop photocard vault and marketplace: cards vaulted in Seoul, ownership as Solana NFTs, settled in USDT, redeemable anytime.
Meta.vaultDescription: Every vaulted photocard with its Solana NFT, holder and status, publicly verifiable.
Meta.packsDescription: Open a pack and pull an authenticated, vaulted K-pop photocard. Finite pools, live odds, on-chain randomness.

Meta.binderDescription: Your K-pop photocard collection, organized like a real binder. Mint the cards you own.

Hero.body: Send your cards to Idolca. Once authenticated, each one gets its own NFT on Solana. When it sells, the card stays in the vault while the NFT and USDT swap in a single transaction, so no more mailing cards back and forth or worrying about fakes. Want to hold it? Burn the NFT and we ship it anywhere.
Hero.hint: Drag to rotate and see the back

How.title: Cards stay in the vault, trading happens on-chain
How.subtitle: No more unshipped orders, fakes or cross-border postage. Every card has a unique serial and its full history is public on-chain.
How.s1Body: Mail your cards to our Seoul vault, or open albums online and have your pulls vaulted directly.
How.s2Body: Each card is authenticated and scanned front and back, then minted as its own NFT on Solana.
How.s3Body: The card never moves. An escrow program swaps the NFT and USDT in one transaction, and you can also trade on Magic Eden or Tensor.
How.s4Body: Request redemption and the NFT is frozen, then burned when the card ships. Combine several cards into one worldwide shipment.

Vault.intro: Every card in the vault maps to one Metaplex Core NFT. The number of unburned NFTs always equals the number of physical cards: NFTs of cards being redeemed are frozen, and burned when the card ships.

Packs.title: Mystery Pack
Packs.subtitle: Open a pack and pull a real, authenticated photocard from the vault. Every pool is finite, odds are live, and every pull can be verified.
Packs.chance: {price} USDT for a chance at {top} USDT
Packs.how1Body: Each pack has a fixed pool of cards that are physically in the vault. Odds are published and update as the pool sells.
Packs.how2Body: Open 1, 5 or 10 at a time and flip each card. Every pull is drawn from the cards left in the pool.
Packs.how3Body: The card's NFT moves to your wallet. Keep it in the vault, list it, sell it back instantly, or redeem the physical card.
Packs.expectedBody: {rtp}% of the price at the current pool. It changes as cards are pulled.
Packs.oddsSubtitle: Each tier's share of the cards still in the pool.
Packs.noPulls: No pulls yet. Be the first when the pack opens.
Packs.fairCommit: Before sales open we publish the SHA-256 of a secret seed. When the pack ends or sells out, the seed itself is published.
Packs.fairNft: Every pool card is a real card in the vault. The one you pull moves from Idolca's wallet to yours and stays vaulted until you redeem it.
Packs.rule18: 18+ only, and unavailable in some regions.
Packs.ruleBuyback: Instant buyback pays {pct}% of the card's value in this pack, in USDT.
Packs.ruleShipping: Shipping is charged only when you redeem cards.

Packs.promoBody: Finite pools of real vaulted cards, live odds and provably fair draws.
Packs.linkWalletToOpen: Link a wallet from the account menu to open packs.
Packs.chainNote: Real transactions on Solana: you pay in USDT, and each card you pull is a vaulted card whose NFT moves to your wallet. Sell one back and the NFT and payment swap in one transaction.

Packs.fairDraw: Each pull's random number is HMAC-SHA256(seed, your payment signature : pull number). Your wallet creates the signature, so Idolca can't know the result in advance. The draw log lets anyone recompute every pull.

Admin.title: Admin console
Admin.intro: Vault intake (including user-minted cards sent in for authentication), mystery pack pools, escrow disputes, redemptions and fake-card reports. Only admin accounts can open this page.
Admin.redemptionsHint: The owner froze the NFT when requesting. Shipping thaws and burns it in one transaction.
Admin.itemsHint: Marking a card fake is permanent on-chain and removes it from sale.
Admin.fakeConfirm: Mark this card fake? On-chain this is permanent.
Admin.ordersHint: Disputed orders first. Refund returns the full price to the buyer and relists the card; release sends the NFT to the buyer and the payment to the seller.
Admin.refundConfirm: Refund the full price to the buyer? This sends a transaction and can't be undone.
Admin.releaseConfirm: Send the NFT to the buyer and the payment to the seller? This can't be undone.
Admin.intakeHint: After a physical card passes authentication: photograph both sides, fill in the card and shelf location, and mint its vault NFT. Leave the depositor empty for Idolca's own stock (e.g. mystery pack pools).
Admin.login: Log in with an admin account
Admin.packsHint: Create a pack (a secret seed is generated and only its hash is published), then add Idolca-owned vault cards to its pool with a tier and value. Value drives expected value and buyback.
Admin.assignHint: Pick a tier and value, then add cards below.
Admin.redeemCancelConfirm: Cancel this redemption? The NFT is unfrozen and the shipping fee refunded.
Admin.returnConfirm: Return the card without converting it? The collector NFT stays as it is.
